text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of performance do you put on to 
please your fans?" ...is that it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Actually, the other day, I 
received an invitation to a fan meetup—a 
gathering for the "Yaeno Muteki Brigade."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To express my gratitude for their daily 
support, I wish to liven up the gathering 
in some way... However, I cannot seem to 
come up with any ideas.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you often participate in fan 
interaction events, Oguri-san. I would be 
honored to hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if that's the case, leave it to me. 
I've got just the thing.
*(Slurp, slurp, slurrrrppp!)*

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. Th... Thank you... 
for the meal...

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Whoaaa!? You two sure can put it away! 
—Give it your all in your next races too~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
How was that? This is my special routine— 
the "100 Bowls of Ramen Competitive Eating 
Act"!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I-Indeed... it certainly had... 
presence... ...and... got everyone... 
hyped... ............

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yaeno? What's wr—... YAENO!?!?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: BURNING ATTACCCCKKK!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! As expected of you, Yaeno...! To 
pull it off so flawlessly!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely use these movements as a 
reference—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: NOT YET!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I just realized. This doesn't match 
Yaeno's fighting spirit at all. We need to 
polish this routine even more. So—!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! I'll turn this into an even 
more amazing act, ya hear meee!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
!? Bamboo-san!? F-For you to go to such 
lengths—!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: FEEEEVEEER!! Woo! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—You go, girls, looking fierce~~! —Keep 
striving toward your dreams~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How was that? This performance was taught 
to me directly by Maruzen-san, desu ne! 
Look at how excited everyone is!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I-It seems so, but... how should I put 
this... ...well............

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You can't be shy! You have to unleash 
yourself! Just feel the sparkle of the 
mirror ball in your heart—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: U-Unleash... myself...!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yaeno-san, are you heading to dinner 
now as well? In fact, I just finished my 
laps around the perimeter—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ramen... burning... fever...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: !? Y-Yaeno-san...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you have lost sight of what 
you should perform.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case... let us see. Why not take a 
step back and re-examine what it is you 
truly must do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The ones you wish to bring joy to are your 
own fans, correct?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
? Of course. After all, it is an event 
organized by my fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then what you need to know is... not what 
pleases Oguri-san's fans, is it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...How shameful of me. It appears I had 
overlooked what is most important.

One day, while walking through the academy 
grounds... I noticed Yaeno Muteki lost in 
thought. Concerned, I called out to ask 
what was wrong—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have been agonizing over a performance 
that would truly showcase my appeal and 
bring joy to my fans.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. This is something I must realize on my 
own. I shall certainly put on a 
performance that is true to myself for my 
fans...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. This is something I must realize on my 
own. I must find a suitable performance at 
all costs...
